Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Hmm? Ni. (Grinding) (Looks at another stone) Hmm? Ni. (Throws it in Bunka's mouth) Ah? Ni. (Camera pans to Bunka, who grinds another stone. A squirrel rolls by balancing on a nut) Gerb? (Gerb shows a stone) Ah! (Camera pans to the stone) Oh wha!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Mei Isabelock, Gerb n mi maka wha.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa. So—so they're just gonna be talking in "cave-talk"?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Yeah! I think Doofenshmirtz is just gonna grunt.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Oh—How are people gonna know what's going on?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Oh—Periodically we're just gonna cut to you and me, just explaining it just like this in this sort of photo-animation.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Wh—Why don't we just film it? Live action?

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Ah, yeah. How are the kids gonna know who we are?

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Oh! That's nice. Okay. But where's Perry?

Name: Dan
Dialog: (Prepares to write on the drawing board) Ah!

Name: Monobrow
Dialog: Meh ti bi bunga gunga. Unga gunga Doofengung gugga lunga.

Name: Monobrow
Dialog: Unga lunga alunga. Gunga lunga bleh ah...

Name: Caveman
Dialog: Ugga bugga bajunga ba googoo googa di wha?

Name: Mog
Dialog: Ah bu ga bu dar. Dan doo par gu spar.

Name: Mog
Dialog: Bakoo ar! (Mog unbends her back. She walks to a mirror and sees her hair) Chakka lakka! Can-tok? (Gets her staff) Igga raba oh.

Name: Mog
Dialog: Ah, Can-tok. Yar in charga. (Gives Can-tok the staff)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ah quag, Mog! (Looks at the staff) Can-tok in charga. Ee-ee-ee-ee!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk and Gerb! Can-tok in charga!

Name: Phinabuk
Dialog: Can-tok in charga? Du mhakka satellakkah?

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Ah, Bunka da Bunkaquan... bakka lakka!

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Uh? Blahh! (A piece of a stalactite breaks off) Uh? Blahh! Uh? Blahh! Uh? BLAHH!!!

Name: Dan
Dialog: You know what? I think you're right. This was a bad idea.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: No, no, no, no... This is starting to work. This is really good.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Yeah. Get, get up, get up, get out of the way! Give me the pen. So Phinabunk and Gerb have already invented the wheel and are getting ready to show their friends...

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Ah, ta-da! (He hums as he rolls with his wheel. He stops at Boofgard and gets off) Ta-da!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Oh! (Walks outside) Phinabunk and Gerb, gu bagga da da da!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk an Gerb, du go gunga busta! Mi tele Mog! (Calls out) Mog!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: (Points and commands each of the others, who are riding their own wheels) Da! Da! Da!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Hmmm, Gerb, tu kanga machia du kanga!

Name: Phinabunk
Dialog: Gerb? (Gerb displays a small tablet inscribed with what appears to be a Humvee design)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog! Phinabunk and Gerb gunga bunga doo wha! Doo wha! Doo wha! (Pause) DOO WHAAAAAA!

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Ah, Bunka da Bunkaquan. Eh. (Laughs) Ah rar! (Opens the curtains) Da may deh herayar! (Picks the Stick-Inator up) Ah? Eh? (Camera pans to Bunka) Ah! (Shows a stone drawing) Eh, Bunka da Bunkaquan. (Taps the stone drawing) Eh? Heh, eh? Heh?

Name: Dan
Dialog: Oh, so Doof's going to poke the mammoths with his Stick-inator and they'll stampede Roger and his friends away from their home, and Doof can live there.

Name: Swampy
Dialog: Well, then it's a good thing we're doing (Does a pose) this then.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Can-tok me in charga. Mog neega lunga Can-tok Mog. (Notices a Humvee. The camera zooms out of a wheel, switches to Gerb, who's driving, Phinabunk, Baljug, Isabelock as passengers, and Boofgard is running on its back wheel. As they ride, the kids shout)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Phinabunk and Gerb! (Runs after it. At a glacier he notices Jerabunk)

Name: Conk
Dialog: (Laughs) Phinabunk and Gerb! (The camera zooms out, noticing his foot stuck in the glacier) Ah! Bungah.

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: (Screams) (Lands on a tree, slides down it, breaking it's branches and slides down the volcano. As she stops, the rock on the staff is in the lava)

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Oh! Phinabunk and Gerb! Can-tok busta Phinabunk and Gerb! (Picks up the staff, noticing steam billowing from the rock) Shtok smoke il lakka? (Grabs the steam and lets go of it) Ah?

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: (Gasps) Mog! (Notices Mog, then the kids and the Humvee) Mog busta Phinabunk and Gerb! (Starts running) Mog! Mog!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog! Phinabunk and Gerb makka du kanga!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Mog, butta! (Notices that the Humvee is broken) Ni! (runs up to it) Ni, ni, ni, ni!

Name: Can-tok
Dialog: Ah, Can-tok makka foomfa! (holds the staff high) Can-tok in charga.

Name: Doofengung
Dialog: Kooya, Bunka da Bunkaquan! (Seeing Bunka walking away) Aw, bunka!

Name: Gerb
Dialog: I guess we should wait until tomorrow before we tell them about our new language.

Name: Dan
Dialog: Eh, all right, I'll buy that, but it still feels like it's missing something.

Name: Baljug
Dialog: (Yaiiii, yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yai yaaiioh!)
